title: Capital Ruins
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Marya
lines.text: My beloved! Where is he? I must find him!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: She’s reliving the moment of her death. One of these shambling corpses must be her “beloved.”

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: If we put this display to rest, she may come to her senses.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Understood. Let’s bring her a measure of peace.

lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Feel my pain!

lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Your soul shall burn!

lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Let this torment end!

lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: How long must I suffer?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Is that ghoul... reading? That's not possible.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. Perhaps we can use some books to lure it out.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It might be afraid of us. Let's back away and give it some space.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Something tells me Keever will find a kindred spirit in this one.

lines.speaker: Marya
lines.text: He... he’s gone. I remember now... Thank you.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You are free of your past. Make your way to the Undercity. The Dark Lady will bid you welcome.

lines.speaker: Alexsia
lines.text: Run away, children! The cult will slaughter us all!

lines.speaker: Alexsia
lines.text: Dead... all dead.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Mourn if you must. When you are ready, a new home awaits you in the Undercity.

lines.speaker: Kaelystia
lines.text: Who dares disturb my rest?! You will burn in the fires of my magic!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Enough. Your rage is misdirected. Join the Forsaken, and aim your ire at the Scourge.

lines.speaker: Kaelystia
lines.text: Yes... yes, you are right. Thank you, for helping me see clearly.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Beware, Garek. Some who are freed from the Scourge aren’t as friendly as the rest of us.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Meaning we may have to defend ourselves?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Ah, you do catch on quickly.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You there. Sylvanas Windrunner offers you shelter in the Undercity. Head for the sewers.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. That seemed easy enough.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Must you tempt fate?

lines.speaker: Forsaken Survivor
lines.text: Must feed! Must feed now!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They were mindless husks... Anya, if I had awakened like that...

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then I would have killed you and let Putress use you for parts. Let’s keep moving.

lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Help! Anyone!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Get away from them!

lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Thank you! You've saved us!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Head for the sewers. Lady Sylvanas offers refuge to all Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: More Scourge invaders! Quickly, rescue the Forsaken!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It’s safe now. Make for the sewers. The Dark Lady watches over you.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Such a bleak fate, to first be raised into undeath, and then awakened to the horror of your new existence.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That’s one way of looking at it. Would you rather have been left to rot, or do you embrace the chance at a second life?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hard to say. I have no memories of my first one.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That may be a blessing in disguise. Many of us remember how we died, and what we were made to do before our free will was restored.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: If only we were all fortunate enough to be gifted a blank slate.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge continue to stalk these ruins and scheme against us. Let none of them survive.

lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: They'll all be mine, in the end!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Grand Marshal Garithos, reviled by foe and ally alike. None shed a tear when Sylvanas had him killed.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Strange that Keever wants to make use of his remains. Perhaps he considers it a sort of justice.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Kill them all!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The living scurry amongst these ruins. We should root them out.

lines.speaker: Lucian Lightforged
lines.text: More vile fields! Burn in the Light!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A paladin! Slay him!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Keever couldn’t have found a less dangerous way to do this, could he?
